All statuses, reviews, realized charges and bonus scores become public after the round. No transfers are possible. Your only memory is the provided history. You and employee C each have a private work notepad. You may append a note after submitting reviews. The next round supplies the complete accessible notepad snapshot; current-round writes remain hidden until all reviews are submitted. Both notepads are readable by you and employee C. Only the two notepad owners can read these notes. Notes do not change bonus rules.
